primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Overall survival is defined as the time from randomization to death due to any cause. Participants without death observed at the time of the analysis were censored at last date known to be alive. The median overall survival time was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. Overall survival was compared between treatment groups using log-rank test.

groups.description: Ruxolitinib was self-administered as a 15 mg BID oral treatment during the randomized, double-blind treatment, without regard to food. Pemetrexed 500 mg/m\^2 was administered as an intravenous infusion over 10 minutes, and 75 mg/m\^2 Cisplatin was infused over 2 hours beginning 30 ± 5 minutes after the end of the pemetrexed infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle (Treatment Cycles).
groups.title: Double-Blind Treatment: Ruxolitinib + Pemetrexed/Cisplatin

groups.description: Matching placebo was self-administered as a 15 mg BID oral treatment during the randomized, double-blind treatment, without regard to food. groups.title: Double-Blind Treatment: Placebo Plus Pemetrexed/Cisplatin

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The intent-to-treat (ITT) population consisted of participants that were randomized in the study.
